The [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="Part 1">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-an-overview-of-popular-music-and-musicians-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away-part-1|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]],<ref name="SWI 67" /> located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]],<ref name="TEGtPaM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> contained a seedy bar called '''Uncle Chesko's''',<ref name="SWI 67" /> which was a worn-out tapcafe near a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] port.<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|46|MAX 1-2|The Max Rebo Band}}</ref> By sometime during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Part 2">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-part-2|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> a conflict that lasted from [[22 BBY/Legends|22]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Music/Legends|music]] within Uncle Chesko's attracted the [[Yuzzum/Legends|Yuzzum]] [[Joh Yowza/Legends|J'ywz'gnk Kchhllbrxcstk Et'nrmdndlcvtbrx]], who burst into song and attracted the attention of others in the bar,<ref name="SWI 67" /> while the band [[Evar Orbus and His Galactic Jizz-Wailers]] was performing at Uncle Chesko's.<ref name="FF" /> Due to his delighted surprise at Et'nrmdndlcvtbrx's performance, the [[Evar Orbus/Legends|eponymous]] lead [[Musician/Legends|musician]] invited the Yuzzum to join the band.<ref name="SWI 67" />

==Behind the scenes==
Uncle Chesko's was first indirectly mentioned in [[1997]]'s ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', a supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="SETSB">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref> The bar was first named in "[[Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band]]," an article [[Rich Handley]] wrote for the [[Star Wars Insider 67|sixty-seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="SWI 67" /> which was published on [[April 15]], [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/03/news20030317.html|text=Celebrate <i>Jedi</i>'s 20th in ''Insider'' #67}}</ref>
